# Opaque Frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:OpaqueFrame`](gmeow-OpaqueFrame.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/OpaqueFrame>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gts`](../../slices/gts.md)

A sealed or undecodable region of a GTS segment, surfaced by the reader as a first-class object rather than dropped (spec §7.6): an encrypted frame the reader holds no key for, a frame using a codec the reader lacks, or a damaged frame. Opacity is VANTAGE-RELATIVE epistemic state, not a property of the bytes — the same frame is transparent to a recipient holding the key (standpoint/privacy, [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). The frame's bytes remain present, hash-linked, and chain-verifiable.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:OpaqueFrame`](gmeow-OpaqueFrame.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
